connector.name: SpherePay
connector.registryDescription: Manage SpherePay customers, bank accounts, wallets, and transfers from Claude.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package spherepay-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the danchev account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SPHEREPAY_API_KEY
env.description: Your SpherePay API key (Bearer token). Get one at https://dashboard.spherepay.co

env.name: SPHEREPAY_BASE_URL
env.description: API base URL. Use https://api.sandbox.spherepay.co for testing or https://api.spherepay.co for production.

env.name: SPHEREPAY_MAX_RETRIES
env.description: Maximum retry attempts for transient failures (default: 3)
